brief.title: Every Child Deserves to Learn
brief.one_liner: Millions of children worldwide are still denied their right to quality education — UNICEF is working to change that.
brief.goal: Viewers should understand the scale of the global education crisis, recognize the key barriers children face, and feel motivated to support efforts ensuring every child has access to inclusive, quality education.

sections.title: The Global Education Crisis
sections.objective: Present the scale of the problem with hard-hitting statistics on out-of-school children and learning poverty.

sections.title: Barriers to Education
sections.objective: Highlight the main obstacles — conflict, poverty, gender inequality, disability, and climate change — that keep children out of school.

sections.title: UNICEF's Education Focus Areas
sections.objective: Summarize UNICEF's key programmatic pillars for improving education outcomes worldwide.

sections.title: What Can Be Done
sections.objective: Inspire action by outlining concrete steps and the vision of education as a fundamental child right aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals.
